bundleBaseline.measuredAt: 2026-08-23, on the merge of main's xFrontier integration into the seven depth families
bundleBaseline.entryBudgetRationale: The 900 KiB budget is unchanged and was not raised to fit new data. What changed is that the seed structure catalogue no longer sits in the entry at all. Waves 4 and 5 added 37 structures (49.3 KiB and 38.1 KiB of source), and the wave-5 build failed the guard at 917.0 KiB against 900 — correctly, because api/structureFallback was statically imported by two eager screens and chart/connectionField pulled a two-line slugOfOp helper out of the same module, anchoring the whole catalogue on the first-paint path. The code fix is a cherry-pick of 6a7f953 from the wave-3 branch, taken verbatim so the later merge stays clean; only these measurements are this branch's own, because that branch measures a 371-island atlas against a 1024 KiB budget and neither number describes this tree. Entry now measures 701.15 kB raw / 230.45 kB gzip, 176.87 kB below the 2026-08-04 baseline it replaces, and the catalogue loads as its own 238.37 kB chunk when a reader opens the structure lens. Note how the wave-4 commit got here: it reported typecheck and test green without running pnpm build, which is in neither gate. It happened to pass with roughly 21 KiB of headroom, but that was luck rather than verification, and it is the same gap 6a7f953 documents.
bundleBaseline.depthLayerRationale: This is the measurement that shows the deferral doing its job, and it is the reason to record it rather than assume it. Between the 2026-08-22 reading and this one, seven depth families gave 56 of the 126 seed structures their own content: origin, minimal form, canonical substrates in other disciplines, relations to other structures, and what each is mistaken for. That is 193 substrates across 120 disciplines and 118 relations, and it more than doubled the catalogue. structureFallback went 238.37 -> 560.14 kB raw, up 321.77. The entry chunk moved 701.15 -> 710.52 kB, up 9.37 — which is the depth type declarations and nothing else, because the catalogue itself is reached only when a reader opens the structure lens. Merging main added a further 0.70 for the xFrontier feedback path, giving 711.22 kB and 205.5 KiB of headroom against the unchanged 900 KiB budget. The thing to watch is not the entry number but the ratio: content grew 34x faster in the deferred chunk than in the eager one, and if a future edit makes that ratio fall, something has been statically imported back onto the first-paint path. Measured by gzip -9 on the built assets after pnpm build, not by the bundler report.
